name: Ramtel Corporation
old_description: Ramtel specializes in Custom Silk Screened phone panels, individualized to your needs
about:
Ramtel Corporation, based in Johnston, Rhode Island, was founded in 1983 as Ramtech following the divestiture of the telephone industry and a collaboration with an Ivy League university in New England. The company set out to solve the vandalism and durability problems of standard receiver phones by developing the first hands-free security phone.

Today Ramtel manufactures a range of security communication products including custom silk-screened phone panels, one-button and dual-purpose hands-free phones in standard and mini sizes, multi-button phones, elevator phones with stainless steel panels, and area-of-refuge phones. The company fabricates its own non-rusting stainless steel columns, anodizes aluminum panels, applies conformal coating to electronics, and performs in-house quality assurance testing at every production stage. All products are assembled in the USA.

Ramtel serves safety and security integrators, educational institutions (K‑12), campus security departments, elevator contractors, and commercial building owners. Its phones are compatible with more than 30 PBX and VoIP platforms—including Avaya, Cisco, Asterisk, and Siemens—and are deployed for emergency assistance, elevator communication, entrance security, and area-of-refuge applications.

The company emphasizes that it is the only U.S. manufacturer producing non-rusting stainless steel columns, and it differentiates itself through a fierce commitment to custom solutions, rapid introduction of new features, and end‑to‑end customer support from engineering through installation.
